# Work item N-0112

**Title:** Deleting an import job removes the data it loaded and restores what it superseded  
**Class:** feature  
**Status:** in_progress  
**Stage:** design  
**Revision:** 4  
**Risk:** R3  
**Execution risk class:** full  
**Execution:** full loop  
**Execution charter:** _unset_  
**Facets:** api, data_migration, schema, ui

## Acceptance criteria

- The existing Import Center job delete, its admin preview and bulk delete are extended, no parallel path
- Deleting a job removes the fact rows it loaded in every fact table that references import_job (sell-through, distributor sell-out, returns, inventory, shipments) and its staging
- Figures the job superseded come back from the superseded tables, and the superseded records the job owns are removed
- If a later job has since superseded the figures, the later figures stay and the preview says so
- Stock positions are recomputed for every customer touched, and the distributor-derived tables for every distributor touched
- The preview shows plain counts per job and accepts job ids typed or pasted, in batches of up to 200
- All or nothing with full rollback, and a platform_audit_event records the counts
- Learned aliases are kept by default
- Clone proof: load real, load test over it, delete test, real figures identical, plus a distributor case
- Full API pytest and full web vitest green on cip_test, web tsc clean

## Stage note

Design (2026-10-22): bulk_delete_import_jobs calls JobDataRemoval (services/imports/import_job_delete_figures.py) before the job rows go, in the same transaction; preview runs the same code and rolls back, so preview counts equal delete counts. Per fact row a deleted job holds: walk back to the newest holder that stays, using the superseded record the deleted job wrote, else the earlier load's staging lines (CST per figure via figure_import_jobs; DSI sell-out/returns per line; inventory from staging; shipped shipments from other loads' evidence lines, open orders removed). Later loads that stay keep their figures; their records are relinked past the deleted job. Superseded records the deleted jobs wrote or hold are removed (migration 20261022_0047 adds DELETE policies). Then: report slots reopened, distributor-derived tables rebuilt per distributor touched, stock positions recomputed per customer touched. Aliases kept by default (link cleared). platform_audit_event area admin action import_jobs_delete with counts per job.
